class.name: IfcFaceBasedSurfaceModel
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A face based surface model is described by a set of connected face sets of dimensionality 2. The connected face sets shall not intersect except at edges and vertices, except that a face in one connected face set may overlap a face in another connected face set, provided the face boundaries are identical. members.member: The set of connected face sets comprising the face based surface model.
